accuracyAdjudication.status: Official-source adjudication 2026-10-19 (FENZ, DOC, NZTA, MPI, legislation.govt.nz)
rejectedFlags: Gas stove 'unaffected by fire seasons' vs section 05 'a prohibited season can restrict some appliances': not a contradiction. FENZ 'Fire types and their status' fact sheet (27 Sep 2023) authorises gas appliances in restricted and prohibited seasons, while braziers, fire pits/bowls and drum incinerators are prohibited in a prohibited season. https://www.fireandemergency.nz/assets/Documents/Fire-season-and-permits/Fire-types-fact-sheet.pdf ; DOC: https://doc.govt.nz/contentassets/0b12e87b3b4a44a89fc2be792d17ab76/auth-fire-types-prohibited-season.pdf
Fire season descriptions match FENZ guidance; missing verification date is a style point, not an error.
editorialSuggestions: Optional: section 05 'non-gas appliances such as braziers and incinerators'; FAQ 'gas stoves are authorised in all fire seasons if used safely' (FENZ ties authorisation to checkitsalright.nz safe-use guidance).
auditorFlagsBefore: FAQ says a gas stove 'is unaffected by fire seasons' while section 05 says a prohibited season 'can restrict some appliances too': contradictory.
Fire season descriptions (open/restricted/prohibited, FENZ permits, checkitsalright.nz) match FENZ guidance; no dated 2026 verification stamp.
